title: Human Traffic of Stadium
goal: Return visits belonging to a run of at least three consecutive IDs with attendance of at least 100.
strategy: First remove low-attendance visits, then split the remaining sorted IDs wherever a gap appears. Calendar-day gaps do not matter: only consecutive visit IDs form a qualifying run.

phasePurposes.done: Return visits belonging to a run of at least three consecutive IDs with attendance of at least 100.

edgeCases: Two busy records are not a qualifying run
Calendar gaps do not break consecutive visit IDs
An empty stadium has no qualifying visits
